'''Squad Six''' was a [[squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid]]s led by an [[OOM command battle droid]]. The squad was part<ref name="Last Battle" /> of [[General]] [[Kalani]]'s [[Agamar garrison|garrison]]<ref name="USNWE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> on [[Agamar]]. After a [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|skirmish]] against several rebels from [[Phoenix Cell]], the half of Squad Six was destroyed but the other half survived. The [[Separatist holdouts|Separatist holdout]] and the rebels then ceased hostilities and fought together against the [[Galactic Empire]]. The former [[clone trooper]] [[Captain]] [[Rex]] and Kalani reconciled and agreed to an unofficial end to the Clone Wars by the end of the mission, and the remainings members of Squad Six escaped with Kalani and the rebels from Agamar.<ref name="Last Battle" />
